| # Address claimed (PGN = 0xEE00) {#address-claimed-pgn-0xee00-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                          |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

With this PGN another controller can ask for a comparison of the controller application (CA) names. If this PGN was received then the following results are possible:

 

- No answer message will be sent if the received and own addresses are different.

An \'Address Claim\' message will be sent if the addresses are equal and the own CA name has a lower value (= higher priority).

- If the addresses are equal and the own CA name has the same value or a higher value (= lower priority) then there exist 2 possibilities:

oIf the arbitrary address capability is not activated then a \'Cannot Claim Address\' message will be sent.

oIf the arbitrary address capability is activated then an \'Address Claim\' message will be sent with a new source address.
